title: Return before reopening every question
summary: Doubt weakens when lived remembrance outruns inner argument. Stay with one clear line until doubt loses room.
takeaway: Stay with one clear line until doubt loses room.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts circling again, write the one instruction you already know and keep it before asking another question.

source.shortMeaning: Doubt weakens when lived remembrance outruns inner argument.
source.lifeApplication: Before researching one more answer, repeat the clearest line you already trust until your breathing slows.

evidence.coreClaim: Doubt weakens when lived remembrance outruns inner argument.
evidence.turn: When remembrance is real, it reaches the mouth and the walk.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind starts circling again, write the one instruction you already know and keep it before asking another question.
